data.configHy2:
server: @HY2_SERVER

auth: @HY2_AUTH

tls:
  sni: @HY2_DOMAIN
  insecure: true

congestion:
  type: bbr
  bbrProfile: standard

socks5:
  listen: 127.0.0.1:@SOCKS_PORT
  blockQuic: true
  MaxDiscardPeriod: 15s

fastOpen: true

quic:
  maxIdleTimeout: 20s
  keepAlivePeriod: 5s
  disablePathMTUDiscovery: true
data.configTun:
tunnel:
  # Interface name
  name: tun0
  # Interface MTU
  mtu: 1500
  # Multi-queue
  multi-queue: false
  # IPv4 address
  ipv4: 10.0.88.88
  # IPv6 address
  ipv6: 'fc00::1'

socks5:
  # Socks5 server port
  port: @SOCKS_PORT
  # Socks5 server address (ipv4/ipv6)
  address: 127.0.0.1
  # Socks5 UDP relay mode (tcp|udp)
  udp: 'udp'

misc:
  max-session-count: 1800
  limit-nofile: 65535
